name: Manfu Futou 4th
source:
In the last volume, the main character has built a good relationship with Gu*n Yu and now visits his lord, Liu B*i. Zhao Y*n feels suspicious about the main character and keeps an eye on him to prevent any damage to Liu B*i. The main character tries to get his hands on Liu B*i and Zhao Y*n using hypnosis.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047638.html]DLsite English[/url]]
